transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Thank you. Um, what brings me in is... well, I'm just exhausted. It's a kind of tired that sleep doesn't really fix. Lately, just getting through a normal workday, and then figuring out dinner at home... it all just feels a lot heavier than it should right now.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things as much as you used to, even things you typically like doing?

Yeah, I have. Normally I really love painting, or just wandering through museum exhibits. But recently... I just leave my art supplies sitting there untouched. I look at them, but I just can't make myself care enough to actually paint, or to go out to a museum. It just doesn't hold my interest right now.
Have you noticed a decrease in your energy levels or an increase in fatigue, even after resting or sleeping?

Yeah, like I was mentioning when we first started talking... that's exactly it. It's this exhaustion that just doesn't go away, even if I get plenty of rest. Like I said earlier, just making it through my workday and then trying to manage dinner at home feels so much heavier than it usually does. I just don't have the energy for it.
Have you noticed feeling down or sad most of the day, even when there's no clear reason for it?

Yes, I have. Um... most days lately, I just wake up with this heavy, gray feeling. It's like... I'm already disappointed in the day before it even starts. And there's really no clear reason for it, it's just there.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy or take interest in almost any activities, even ones you used to really like?

Um, isn't that what we just talked about? With the painting and the museums? Like I said a minute ago, I just don't have any interest in doing those things right now. I don't really have anything else to add to that, it's just... yeah, I'm not enjoying much of anything lately.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yeah, I have. My appetite has definitely gone down. I've just been picking at my meals, or... honestly, sometimes I completely forget to eat lunch while I'm at work. And I've noticed my skirts for work are fitting a little looser lately, even though I haven't been trying to lose weight at all.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, even if they don’t seem like a big deal to others?

Yes, I have. I just keep... replaying things in my head a lot lately. Like every missed family plan, or every tense conversation I've had with my husband. I just feel like I’m letting everyone down right now—as a wife, a mother, and even at work as a manager. It just really weighs on me.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still lately?

Yeah, I think I have been. Actually, my staff at work has noticed it, too. They mentioned that I'm slower to answer questions during our meetings lately. It's like... there's just this pause before I can get my thoughts together and actually get the words moving. So, yes, I definitely feel a bit slower in that sense.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had trouble with energy and motivation?
Yes, I have. Um, the longest stretch I can clearly remember feeling like this... it lasted for about five months. I just felt low, tired all the time, and really not like myself most days.
Was that the only time you’ve felt this way, or have you had other separate periods where you felt down and lost interest in things?

Um... no, I don't think so. That five-month stretch is really the only one that stands out to me. I mean, I've had bad days here and there, like anyone, but... as far as a long period where I felt that down and just lost interest in everything, that was really the only time I can clearly remember.
How long ago was that five-month period you mentioned, and have you had any other episodes since then?

Um... I'm really not sure exactly how long ago it was, to be honest. It's a little hard to pin down a specific year. And, uh, no, I haven't had any other episodes since then. Just that one long stretch I mentioned.
How long has this current period of feeling down, losing interest in things, and having trouble with energy lasted so far?

It's been about a month. Um, it was actually a pretty noticeable swing for me. I had been feeling unusually energized and really driven for a bit, and then it just shifted into this persistently low feeling. So, yeah, this current down period has been going on for about a month now.
Can you recall if there was a period of at least two months between your previous episode and this current one where you felt back to your usual self emotionally and functionally?

Um... yeah, definitely. I mean, since I can't quite remember exactly when that first bad stretch was, I know it was a while ago. There was definitely a long time—way more than two months—where I felt totally normal and was just working and living my life before this recent stuff started.
Can you confirm whether you have had any additional episodes of feeling down and losing interest in things since your previous five-month period and before this current episode?

No, I haven't. Um, it was really just that one long stretch a while back, and then I was completely fine for a long time. So, no, there weren't any other times where I felt down or lost interest in things between then and this past month.

Before this current period of feeling down, have you ever had a time where your mood was unusually elevated, you felt extremely energetic, or you needed less sleep than usual, even if it felt good at the time?

Yes, actually. Earlier in the month, right before this current low period started, I had this unusually charged, upbeat mood. I felt just... brilliant one minute, like I was totally on top of things at work and at home. But then I would get irritated really fast if my husband questioned any of my plans. So, yeah, I definitely had a time like that recently.
How long did that unusually upbeat and energetic mood last before it shifted into your current low period?
It lasted about... well, I'd say maybe four or five days. Yeah, it wasn't a full week, but definitely a few days of feeling really wired and on the go before I just crashed into how I'm feeling now.

Before this recent period of feeling unusually upbeat and energetic, have you ever had another time in your life where your mood was elevated, you felt extremely energetic, or you needed much less sleep than usual?

No, I haven't. That was really the only time I can ever remember feeling like that. Before those few days earlier this month, I've just been my normal self, aside from that long stretch of feeling down a while back. So, no, nothing like that energetic period before now.
Have you ever had at least two separate times in your life where your mood was significantly affected—one of which had to be a period of feeling unusually upbeat, energetic, or needing less sleep?

Well, I'm not entirely sure what you mean by two separate times. Like I said, I had that one period just recently where I felt really energized and upbeat for those few days. And then I had that long stretch of feeling really down a while back, and now I'm feeling down again. But as far as the energetic, upbeat part... no, that only happened the one time, just earlier this month.
